description: Find news where an initial price move reversed, faded by at least half, or continued by the later sample. Or find published analysis of exposure for other companies (read-through), separately from price evidence. Supports ticker, topic and dates. Uses a bounded event sample, not all stocks; returns the actual numbers and headline links, never trade recommendations.

end_utc.description: Exclusive end timestamp with timezone. Overrides the relative look-back window.

include_thin.description: Default false excludes thin trading from price-path screens.

min_initial_move_pct.description: Minimum absolute one-minute move; default 0.5%. Not used for read_through.

query.description: Up to eight headline words, all required, e.g. SpaceX.

screen.description: reversal crosses the original price; faded gives back at least half; continued extends the first move; read_through finds potential effects on other companies.

start_utc.description: Inclusive start timestamp with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-14T00:00:00-04:00.

name: event_screen

label.description: Display name of the measured series.

move_10m_pct.description: Percent move 10 minutes after the headline, measured from price_before.

price_before.description: Price immediately before the headline crossed.

title: Compare news and price responses
